text:
Ravi: morning crisis: thermostat set to 'Arctic Research Station' again. I'm wearing two hoodies. :cold_face:
Ava: haha that was me. I thought it said 'Artist Research Station' and turned it down for creativity vibes.
Noah: please tell me someone recorded the temperature vs creativity correlation.
Priya: we should form a formal treaty. The Tea Treaty: thermostat temp + communal kettle rules.
ben-ops: can we put a sticky on the thermostat that says 'No temperature spikes during standup'?
Ravi: sticky note is fine but last time someone taped a postcard there and it became a shrine.
Zoe: Propose schedule: 8-10am: Warm (for bagels). 10-16: Neutral. 16-18: Cool (for post-lunch meetings). Exceptions for VIPs (aka interns) require a pastry offering.
Ava: pastry offering policy needs legal review. :laughing:
ops-bot: poll created: "Preferred office temp band" 3 options: Toasty (72-75F); Neutral (68-71F); Chill (64-67F). React with :one: :two: :three: to vote.
Noah: I'm team Chill. I have to wear my 'I shipped the bug' hoodie less proudly otherwise.
Priya: Also, kettle etiquette: rule 1 - label tea types. rule 2 - if you finish the kettle, write 'refill pls' and actually refill. rule 3 - no DIY experiments involving cinnamon unless clearly labeled.
ben-ops: Noted. I'll make a tiny laminated card with the Tea Treaty rules and tack it by the kettle.
Ravi: can we name the thermostat? 'Thermy McThermface' was vetoed, suggestions welcome.
Zoe: 'Lord of Climate'
Ava: 'Sir Warm-a-Lot'
Noah: 'The Great Equalizer'
Priya: we should engrave the winner on the laminated card.
hr-bot: Friendly reminder: shared spaces should remain inclusive. Please avoid discriminatory or offensive names.
Ava: totally. leaning into playful.
Ravi: Agreement: we'll vote on the name during the ceremony of kettle stamping (yes, that's a thing now). Friday 11:30?
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Tea Treaty & Thermostat Naming' Friday 11:30 in #random.
Noah: bringing biscuits as a bargaining chip.
Priya: I'll draft the first version of the Tea Treaty doc and drop it here. It'll be short. bullet points.
Zoe: This is peak office folklore. future historians will study our kettle rituals.
Ava: if history asks, tell them 'we were cold and caffeinated.'
